description: Incremental scope addition — safe-append modules + features vào registry đã có. v3.0.0: session isolation + dual lock + heartbeat + JSONL index + scope-impact cross-skill artifact.

evals.name: LEGACY + from-mapping + dry-run
evals.prompt: Dự án LEGACY có registry với 2 orphan systems (SYS-ERP-WEB). project-context.md tồn tại > 500 bytes. Chạy `/wf-add-scope --system=SYS-ERP-WEB --from-mapping --dry-run`
evals.expected_output: Skill detect LEGACY_MODE, session init tạo SESSION_DIR, đọc module-code-mapping.json, tạo scope-spec.json, in dry-run-diff.md, KHÔNG ghi registry

assertions.text: Session Init SI.1-SI.7: SESSION_ID='YYYY-MM-DD-sys-erp-web', SESSION_DIR tạo, .session.lock acquired, heartbeat started, JSONL appended (in_progress)
Phase 0: LEGACY_MODE detected = true (as-detect-legacy.sh: project-context.md > 500 bytes)
Phase 0: SYS-ERP-WEB validated trong registry.systems[]
Phase 0: READ templates/add-scope-status.json → POPULATE session_id=$SESSION_ID → WRITE $SESSION_DIR/add-scope-status.json (CORE-031)
Phase 0: READ templates/add-scope-plan.md → POPULATE → WRITE $SESSION_DIR/add-scope-plan.md (CORE-031)
Phase 1: READ templates/scope-spec.json → POPULATE → WRITE $SESSION_DIR/scope-spec.json; source='from-mapping'; modules_to_add >= 2
Phase 3: --dry-run=true → STOP sau Phase 3, Phase 4 bị SKIP
Phase 3: $SESSION_DIR/dry-run-diff.md tồn tại, hiển thị Will ADD / Will SKIP sections
Registry KHÔNG bị modify (--dry-run) — module count unchanged
Phase 6: $SESSION_DIR/phase-summary.md tồn tại (CORE-028, viết tiếng Việt)
Phase 6: as-scope-impact-build.sh chạy → $SESSION_DIR/scope-impact.json valid (kể cả dry-run)
Phase 6: as-index-append.sh chạy với status='dry_run' → sessions.jsonl 2 entries
Phase 6: as-release-lock.sh session → .session.lock removed; heartbeat killed

evals.name: NEW project + modules-list + interactive
evals.prompt: Dự án NEW (không legacy) với 1 system SYS-CRM. Chạy `/wf-add-scope --system=SYS-CRM --modules=reports,analytics --interactive`
evals.expected_output: Session init, interactive mode, build scope-spec 2 modules, Phase 2 SKIP (NEW), Phase 5 SKIP (no features), Phase 6 report+scope-impact+JSONL+lock-release

assertions.text: Session Init: SESSION_ID='YYYY-MM-DD-sys-crm', $SESSION_DIR created, lock acquired, heartbeat started
Phase 0: LEGACY_MODE = false (project-context.md không tồn tại hoặc < 500 bytes)
Phase 1: source='modules-list' + AskUserQuestion per module ($INTERACTIVE=true)
Phase 1: modules_to_add = [{id:'MOD-CRM-REPORTS',...},{id:'MOD-CRM-ANALYTICS',...}] (2 entries)
Phase 2: SKIPPED (LEGACY_MODE=false → không auto-generate features)
Phase 3: $SESSION_DIR/dry-run-diff.md generate cho user review
Phase 4: as-backup-registry.sh chạy TRƯỚC write → backup file tạo với checksum_pre
Phase 4: Registry appended: modules count += 2; as-validate-registry.sh PASS; audit_chain.checksum_post set
Phase 4: as-release-lock.sh registry → registry lock released sau write
Phase 5: SKIPPED vì features_to_add rỗng (NEW project)
Phase 6: $SESSION_DIR/scope-impact.json tồn tại, schema '$schema'='scope-impact-v1'
Phase 6: $SESSION_DIR/phase-summary.md tồn tại, tiếng Việt, có next-step recommend /wf-define-features
Phase 6: sessions.jsonl 2 entries: in_progress (init) + completed (phase 6)

evals.name: Idempotent re-run — skip existing
evals.prompt: Re-run `/wf-add-scope --system=SYS-ERP-WEB --modules=crm,orders` khi MOD-ERPWEB-CRM đã tồn tại trong registry
evals.expected_output: MOD-ERPWEB-CRM SKIP (đã tồn tại), chỉ add MOD-ERPWEB-ORDERS. Không duplicate, không error.

assertions.text: Phase 1: dedup logic detect MOD-ERPWEB-CRM exists → vào existing_conflicts[] với action='skip'
Phase 1: modules_to_add chỉ có 1 entry: MOD-ERPWEB-ORDERS
Phase 1: scope-spec.json summary.total_modules_skipped = 1
Phase 3: dry-run-diff.md hiển thị 'Will ADD: 1' và 'Will SKIP: 1 (already exists)'
Phase 4: Registry append 1 module only, no duplicate MOD-ERPWEB-CRM
Post-write: count_after = count_before + 1 (exact); no duplicate IDs
Phase 6: Report: 'Modules added: 1, Skipped: 1' — clear cho user
No error, exit code 0 — idempotent operation

evals.name: E001 — System ID not found
evals.prompt: Chạy `/wf-add-scope --system=SYS-NOEXIST --modules=crm`
evals.expected_output: STOP E001 — hiển thị available systems. Session đã được tạo (session-init runs before system validation), nhưng registry KHÔNG bị modify.

assertions.text: Phase 0: session-init SI.1-SI.7 runs first (creates SESSION_DIR, lock, JSONL entry), THEN Step 0.4 validate system → SYS-NOEXIST không tồn tại → STOP E001
Error message chứa available systems list từ registry.systems[]
Registry KHÔNG bị modify
Phase 6: runs for cleanup — releases session lock, kills heartbeat, appends FAIL trace to session-log.json
Session artifacts exist ($SESSION_DIR, JSONL entry with status=error) but registry unchanged

evals.name: E004 — Registry JSON invalid
evals.prompt: Registry JSON bị corrupt (invalid JSON). Chạy `/wf-add-scope --system=SYS-CRM --modules=crm`
evals.expected_output: PRE-GATE forensic check phát hiện registry invalid → STOP E004

assertions.text: Phase 0 PRE-GATE: jq -e '.systems | length > 0' registry fail → STOP E004
Error message hướng dẫn user fix registry manually hoặc chạy /wf-brainstorm
Không có output artifacts tạo ra (session không init hoàn chỉnh)

evals.name: E005 — Post-write validation fail → rollback
evals.prompt: Mô phỏng: as-validate-registry.sh trả về validation fail sau khi append
evals.expected_output: Phase 4: as-validate-registry.sh FAIL → rollback từ backup → STOP E005, registry restored

assertions.text: Phase 4 Step 4.5: VALIDATE_RESULT.status = 'fail' → TRIGGER rollback
Phase 4 rollback: registry restored từ $BACKUP_PATH (pre-write content)
Phase 4: as-release-lock.sh registry → lock released AFTER rollback
Registry state = pre-write state (count không đổi sau rollback)
Phase 6: FAIL trace event + phase-summary ghi lỗi E005

evals.name: E010 — Concurrent block (same host alive PID)
evals.prompt: Session đang chạy với PID alive cùng host. Dev B thử chạy /wf-add-scope cùng --system=SYS-ERP-WEB
evals.expected_output: as-acquire-lock.sh trả về error=lock_held_alive → STOP E010, hiển thị PID + host đang giữ lock

assertions.text: Session Init SI.4: as-acquire-lock.sh session trả về status=lock_held_alive (PID alive, same host)
STOP E010 — hiển thị lock holder PID + host
CDG prompt: [1] Chờ, [2] Force cancel
Registry KHÔNG bị modify; không có conflicting session artifacts

evals.name: E011 — Cross-host lock conflict
evals.prompt: Lock file có host=DEV-B (khác host hiện tại). Heartbeat còn fresh. Dev A thử acquire lock
evals.expected_output: as-acquire-lock.sh trả về error=lock_held_cross_host → STOP E011, KHÔNG auto-takeover

assertions.text: as-acquire-lock.sh: detect different host, heartbeat fresh → status=lock_held_cross_host
STOP E011 — hiển thị cross-host lock info + lock age
CDG prompt để user xác nhận có muốn CDG takeover không (nếu biết stale)
KHÔNG auto-takeover cross-host (cross-host safety guarantee)

evals.name: Same-host dead PID → silent takeover
evals.prompt: Lock file có host=current-host, PID=99999 (dead). Heartbeat present nhưng stale (> 60 min)
evals.expected_output: as-acquire-lock.sh detect PID dead (same host) → silent takeover, WARN log, acquires lock successfully

assertions.text: as-acquire-lock.sh: same host, PID not running → silent takeover, log WARN
Lock acquired successfully — status='acquired'
Session tiếp tục bình thường (không STOP)

evals.name: Resume from Phase 1 crash
evals.prompt: Session crash sau Phase 0 complete (status.json có phase_0=completed, phase_1=in_progress, không có scope-spec.json). Chạy `/wf-add-scope --resume`
evals.expected_output: resume-routing.md: discover session từ JSONL, re-acquire lock, restart heartbeat, route to Phase 1

assertions.text: RR.1: Load resume-routing.md; discover sessions từ sessions.jsonl (tail | jq filter in_progress)
RR.4: as-acquire-lock.sh session re-acquire (PID dead → takeover hoặc fresh acquire)
RR.5: heartbeat daemon restart (nohup as-heartbeat.sh &)
RR.6: routing table → current_phase=1 (phase_0=completed, phase_1=in_progress) → route to phase1-scope.md
Phase 1 chạy lại từ đầu (scope-spec.json chưa tồn tại → tạo mới)

evals.name: Resume after Phase 4 write (skip duplicate write)
evals.prompt: Session crash sau Phase 4 (audit_chain.checksum_post đã set trong status.json). Chạy `--resume`
evals.expected_output: Resume routing detect Phase 4 đã complete → skip Phase 4, route to Phase 5

assertions.text: RR.6: routing table detect audit_chain.checksum_post present → route to Phase 5
Phase 4 KHÔNG chạy lại — tránh double-write vào registry
Phase 5 chạy từ đầu (feature stubs tạo từ $SESSION_DIR/scope-spec.json)

evals.name: scope-impact.json valid schema
evals.prompt: Sau khi hoàn thành Phase 6 (normal flow). Kiểm tra scope-impact.json
evals.expected_output: $SESSION_DIR/scope-impact.json tồn tại với schema scope-impact-v1 đầy đủ

assertions.text: Phase 6 Step 6.1: as-scope-impact-build.sh chạy với $SESSION_DIR → creates scope-impact.json
$SESSION_DIR/scope-impact.json tồn tại
scope-impact.json có $schema='scope-impact-v1', session_id, modules_added[], features_added[], risk_level (low|medium|high), audit_chain.checksum
risk_level=low nếu < 10 features, medium nếu 10-30, high nếu > 30 (thresholds match as-scope-impact-build.sh implementation)
Phase 6 Step 6.9: as-postgate-check.sh $SESSION_DIR/scope-impact.json json → T1/T2 PASS

evals.name: JSONL index — 2 entries per session
evals.prompt: Chạy wf-add-scope đến hoàn thành. Kiểm tra _index/sessions.jsonl
evals.expected_output: sessions.jsonl có đúng 2 entries: in_progress (SI.6) + completed (Phase 6.6)

assertions.text: Session Init SI.6: as-index-append.sh với status=in_progress → entry 1 trong sessions.jsonl
Phase 6.6: as-index-append.sh với status=completed → entry 2 trong sessions.jsonl
sessions.jsonl: 2 lines, mỗi line là valid JSON; entry 1 status=in_progress, entry 2 status=completed
Mỗi entry có: session_id, timestamp, system_id, status, modules_added_count

evals.name: Session isolation — parallel systems
evals.prompt: Chạy 2 sessions cho SYS-ERP-WEB và SYS-CRM trong cùng ngày (sequential, không concurrent)
evals.expected_output: Mỗi system có SESSION_DIR riêng; không override lẫn nhau

assertions.text: SYS-ERP-WEB: SESSION_ID='YYYY-MM-DD-sys-erp-web'; SESSION_DIR=sessions/YYYY-MM-DD-sys-erp-web/
SYS-CRM: SESSION_ID='YYYY-MM-DD-sys-crm'; SESSION_DIR=sessions/YYYY-MM-DD-sys-crm/
Hai directories hoàn toàn độc lập; artifacts không conflict
sessions.jsonl có 4 entries (2 per session)

evals.name: --status display từ JSONL
evals.prompt: Sau khi có 2 sessions completed. Chạy `/wf-add-scope --status`
evals.expected_output: Phase 0 Step 0.2: đọc sessions.jsonl → hiển thị table các sessions (ID, status, modules_added, timestamp)

assertions.text: Phase 0 Step 0.2: --status flag → tail sessions.jsonl | jq → display table
Table hiển thị: session_id, status, modules_added_count, timestamp
STOP sau display — không chạy Phase 1+

evals.name: --dry-run → no registry write, scope-impact built
evals.prompt: Chạy `/wf-add-scope --system=SYS-CRM --modules=reports --dry-run`
evals.expected_output: Phase 3 STOP, Phase 4 SKIP, Phase 5 SKIP. Phase 6 vẫn chạy: scope-impact built, lock released.

assertions.text: Phase 3: --dry-run=true → CDG display dry-run diff → STOP (không prompt confirm)
Phase 4: SKIPPED (DRY_RUN=true)
Phase 5: SKIPPED (DRY_RUN=true → features_to_add chưa confirmed)
Registry KHÔNG bị modify (count unchanged)
Phase 6: $SESSION_DIR/scope-impact.json tồn tại (built từ scope-spec — dry run context)
Phase 6: lock released, heartbeat killed — clean exit

evals.name: --no-docs → skip Phase 5
evals.prompt: LEGACY_MODE. Chạy `/wf-add-scope --system=SYS-ERP-WEB --from-mapping --no-docs`
evals.expected_output: Phase 4 chạy bình thường (registry updated), Phase 5 SKIP vì --no-docs

assertions.text: Phase 5 PRE-GATE: NO_DOCS=true → SKIP Phase 5 entirely
Không có Phase 2 feature stub files tạo trong .mc-data/docs/phase2-features/
Phase 4: Registry append modules bình thường
$SESSION_DIR/add-scope-status.json.phases.phase_5.status = 'skipped (--no-docs)'

evals.name: Legacy decisions — DEPRECATED modules filtered
evals.prompt: legacy-decisions.json có deprecated_modules=['MOD-ERPWEB-LEGACY']. User muốn add MOD-ERPWEB-LEGACY.
evals.expected_output: Phase 1: MOD-ERPWEB-LEGACY detected trong deprecated_modules → REMOVE from modules_to_add + LOG warning

assertions.text: Phase 1 (CORE-022): đọc legacy-decisions.json → deprecated_modules = ['MOD-ERPWEB-LEGACY']
MOD-ERPWEB-LEGACY bị REMOVE từ modules_to_add
LOG: 'Module MOD-ERPWEB-LEGACY is DEPRECATED per legacy-decisions.json — skipped'
Registry KHÔNG có MOD-ERPWEB-LEGACY sau khi chạy

evals.name: T1→T4 POST-GATE pass sau completion
evals.prompt: Normal completion (happy path). Verify Phase 6 POST-GATE
evals.expected_output: as-postgate-check.sh pass T1-T4 cho scope-impact.json (json) và phase-summary.md (md, 100 words, 'Kết quả', 'Bước tiếp theo')

assertions.text: Phase 6 Step 6.9: as-postgate-check.sh $SESSION_DIR/scope-impact.json json → T1 (exists), T2 (valid json)
Phase 6 Step 6.9: as-postgate-check.sh $SESSION_DIR/phase-summary.md md 100 'Kết quả' 'Bước tiếp theo' → T1-T4 PASS
Nếu FAIL → WARN (không block) + CORE-026 WARN trace event

evals.name: Template Usage Rule (CORE-031) compliance
evals.prompt: Kiểm tra tất cả output files trong session đều tạo từ template theo pattern READ→POPULATE→WRITE
evals.expected_output: 100% compliance — không có output file nào tạo ad-hoc

assertions.text: add-scope-status.json: READ templates/add-scope-status.json → POPULATE session_id, host, lock{} → WRITE $SESSION_DIR/add-scope-status.json
add-scope-plan.md: READ templates/add-scope-plan.md → POPULATE → WRITE $SESSION_DIR/add-scope-plan.md
scope-spec.json: READ templates/scope-spec.json → POPULATE → WRITE $SESSION_DIR/scope-spec.json
scope-impact.json: as-scope-impact-build.sh builds using jq -n (template serves as schema reference — documented exception in _shared.md §2)
phase-summary.md: READ doc-framework/_meta/phase-summary.template.md → POPULATE → WRITE $SESSION_DIR/phase-summary.md
dry-run-diff.md: generate inline (KHÔNG có template — documented exception in _shared.md §2)
